authorization.quote_summary: user fixed r5 scope: release core freeze for one address-pipeline change; gates P1 byte-identical, synth WNS>=+0.3, routed zero violations WNS>=+0.2 (floor +0.05 with caveat), 1 bitgen + 1 CWC, exactly 1 SRAM download, COM8 115200 for 120 s with PC decode/CRC; failure stops and there is no second download
authorization.note: the r3 bit download under T10.b3 was already spent; this is a separate single-download authorization for the r5 bit only

package_type: P2 r5: one-level address pipeline on the A+ core htab_p3v -> bm_b.addrb cone (the only routed violator), keeping the r4 UART bypass + heart-beat; then 1 bitgen + 1 CWC + exactly 1 SRAM download + COM8 120 s decode. Core freeze released for this single cone only.

decision.basis: r4 result + three bit-identical route runs: routed WNS -0.274 / 23 endpoints, all u_core/htab_p3v_syn_23.clkb -> bm_b_syn_29.addrb[12:0]; bitgen fail-closed; r3 passed only at +0.012
decision.round_accounting: T10.b2-a1-uart-impl used r0-r4 (4 repair rounds) -> closed as WARN not-passed; r5 work continues under a new independent task id so repair rounds and new-task budget stay separate

supersedes: T10.b3-board-bringup (blocked; its single SRAM download was spent on the r3 bit with UART 0 bytes)

frozen_inputs.core_change_location: copy of upstream a1_deflate_core.v into r0/changed-src/ and redirect the single <File Path> in a1_board.al; upstream/** stays frozen

allowed_change.change: exactly one pipeline/address-register level to break the ERAM-clk2q-to-ERAM-address same-cycle pair; prefer (1) issue the htab read address one cycle earlier so the data is already a flop at s1, or (2) register htab_p3v_q -> htab_p3v_q2 and shift the bm_b issue/consume pair by one cycle; (3) only if 1/2 are impossible, add one bm_b read-data register and delay the hit decision by one cycle
must_not_change: htab_p3v write encoding {valid,pos+3[12:0]}, htab/bm sizes, enc_bank layout
bm prefetch semantics, match/threshold selection, protocol/frame/CRC/byte order/length/DDR layout
SDC / pin constraints / clocks / reset semantics; no false path, no multicycle, no seed sweep, no clock reduction
UART bypass and HB_DIV=4194304 heart-beat; UART_DIV=1628
upstream/** , r3/r4 evidence, P1 r6 manifest, workflow/tasks.json
allowed_change.cycle_neutral: P1 compressed bytes identical; cycles vs r4 (3809 / 5172 / 6421414) growth <=2% accepted with caveat, >2% = throughput regression -> stop

gates.p1_sim: ModelSim UART_DIV=1 HB_DIV=0; micro8x2 / mid64x8 / full_grad byte-identical to r4 (SHA256 match p1-regression-r4.json); raw_drop=0 cmp_drop=0 geom=0 err=0 dup_words=0; exported=1 exp_bytes=40032 cap_bytes=40076; no X/half frame; vlog 0/0
gates.synth: SWNS >= +0.3, STNS >= 0, 0 violated endpoints; record LUT6/reg/ERAM/slice; ERAM incl CWC <= 300; <=3 attempts
gates.route: Routed 0 violations, SWNS >= +0.2 (floor +0.05 acceptable only with explicit caveat in manifest), HWNS >= 0, hold WNS >= 0 / TNS 0, 0 comb loops, 0 unclocked clocks; <=2 attempts, stop if the two are bit-identical
gates.bit: 1 bitgen + 1 CWC (fail-closed release); bit/CWC/BID SHA256 + compiled.bit byte-identical recorded
gates.board: exactly 1 SRAM download; COM8 115200 capture 120 s; PC decode: >=1 complete frame, all four CRC true, decoded_trailing=0, no half frame; heartbeat gaps allowed via resync_decode
gates.fail_closed: route < +0.05 or any violation -> no bitgen, no CWC, no download; submit top paths + root cause to planner; no silent relaxation

board_procedure.port_fallback: one port re-scan only, same window, no extra download
board_procedure.failure: keep raw bin/dec, stop, no second download

forbidden: D:\fpga\ph1p100\upstream\** (read-only source of the frozen copy)
board Flash, PCIe, RK, dual-cam, G4
batch delete (one explicit path at a time only)

path_contract.td: T: = r0/td, Y: = D:\fpga\ph1p100, X: never mapped to project root; run tools/td/td_env.ps1 first

stop_rule: P1 byte mismatch; ERAM >300; 3 synth attempts still < +0.3; 2 route attempts still violated or < +0.05; bitgen/CWC failure; board capture 0 frames or CRC failure; budget exhausted -> stop and return to planner. Never: second download, Flash, SDC change, clock reduction, false path, batch delete.

tester.role: new independent integrated tester (not the r4 developer)
tester.reuse: byte-identical P1 rerun, synth/route/resource/CDC recompute, bit/CWC/BID hashes, board capture re-decode
